newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales moderate at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales moderate at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 20,100 Last Week - 7,600 Year Ago - None
Wk to date- 87,000 Week Ago - 106,700 Year Ago - 26,600
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, couple pens North Plains 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 62.00-63.50. Pen Utility to Choice 2-4 1200 lbs including heiferettes 60.00.

Sales reported on 8,100 slaughter steers and 11,900 heifers; Week to date 87,000 which includes 34,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
